Hindi Title: महाराष्ट्र राज्य व्यवसायोपचार व भौतिकोपचार परिषद अधिनियम, २००२. Long Title: An Act to provide for the constitution of the Maharashtra State Council for Occupational Therapy and Physiotherapy for the purpose of co-ordination and determination of standards of education in the field of Occupational Therapy and Physiotherapy and for the maintenance of a Register of Occupational Therapists and Physiotherapists for the State of Maharashtra and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
